role: Item entity and XP orb probe: spawns EntityItem and EntityXPOrb groups in a raw region scattered with shapes and ticks them the way World.updateEntities does, recording per-tick state, removals and the Det streams, the reference for EntityItem.onUpdate and EntityXPOrb.onUpdate.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make run CLASS=EntityProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}
notes: Its updateEntity, writeDetState and writeDetLine helpers are reused by FallHangProbe and PlaceProbe. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
